newCases.title: RSS-related US lobbying: amended client disclosures
newCases.summary: Official US lobbying records preserve an original RSS client description, a later substitution of an individual’s name, and a termination effective in September 2025. Who authorized and ultimately funded the engagement remains unresolved.
newCases.finding: The original Q3 filing names State Street Strategies (DBA One+ Strategies) on behalf of RSS. The 23 December 2025 amended registration instead names the intermediary on behalf of Vivek Sharma. The latest indexed 29 December amendments report Squire Patton Boggs income estimates of $120,000 for Q1, $100,000 for Q2 and $110,000 for Q3, totaling $330,000 across those three distinct periods. The Q3 amendment records termination effective 30 September 2025; the subject remains introductions of RSS to US officials.
newCases.limitation: These are self-reported, rounded lobbying-income estimates at one firm, not audited remittances from RSS, transfers to India, a finding of unlawful lobbying or evidence of Modi’s direction. Count one latest report per quarter; do not add older versions or intermediary receipts. The actual contracting instructions, source of funds, explanation for amendments and complete subsequent enforcement history were not obtained.
newCases.response: RSS spokesperson Sunil Ambekar denied engaging a US lobbying firm, according to ThePrint. The amended filings identify an individual through the intermediary. DOJ guidance makes the LDA exemption conditional; neither registration nor its absence alone settles legality.

hypotheses.question: Do the original and amended client descriptions reconcile with contemporaneous authorization and payment records?
hypotheses.prediction: If the amendment obscures the actual principal, lawful disclosure of engagement instructions, invoices or contemporaneous correspondence would identify a different authorizing principal than the latest client field, beyond a mere descriptive reference to RSS.
hypotheses.alternative: An independent supporter commissioned lawful advocacy about RSS; the amendment corrects imprecise client wording without concealing a foreign principal or changing the work.
hypotheses.falsifier: Contemporaneous agreement and disclosed payment records establish the amended client chain and independent decision authority, with a documented explanation for the correction.
hypotheses.records: Original and amended LD-1/LD-2 reports; lawful public or voluntarily released engagement letters and invoices; institutional explanation for amendments; applicable public DOJ determinations, if any
nextSteps: Preserve versions and distinguish effective, signature and posting dates
Ask institutions for an explanation before asserting an undisclosed principal; no outreach sent in this review
Reconcile one payment chain without double-counting contractor and subcontractor receipts
Separate public advocacy, representation, funding, control and legal findings
